title: Defer unqualified proof providers and close formal research
commitMessage: docs: qualify formal provider deferral and close M7 C01

contribution.summary: Qualify M7-W02-C01-T2 as an explicit Lean/Rocq/SMT provider and public proof API deferral. Recheck RS118's source-pinned Z[x] polynomial certificate, exact [-1,0,1] convolution and invalid/unproved statuses; require three consumer, trusted-base/resource and source/rights/RID/source-free review gates. Close C01 as research only; keep W02, C02 and M7 open.
contribution.value: An independent read-only C# gate verifies prior fixture/decision/verifier SHA-256 identities, recomputes the finite coefficient certificate and proves wrong/truncated witnesses invalid and missing/hole/timeout/provider errors unproved. Document trust in local BCL BigInteger only; no external kernel, solver, formal Math API, source-free recipient or automatic provider cutover.
debtChanges: One independently verified finite polynomial coefficient witness is not a general theorem prover, Lean/Rocq kernel proof or SMT certificate checker.
Bad or partial complete certificates are invalid; holes, timeouts, missing receipts and failed provider outputs remain unproved, never silently promoted.
A future formal provider requires a named consumer, pinned trusted base/source/version/license/RID, bounded errors/resources and an isolated source-free recipient.
Math may own a qualified certificate data contract only; AURA retains provider invocation, scheduling, permissions and orchestration.
M7-W02-C02 coverage review, W02 portfolio closure and M7 1.2.0-candidate release remain incomplete after RS119.
contribution.nextAction: After durable RS119 success, prepare M7-W02-C02-T1 to independently inventory accepted Math families, migration debt and external owner response status; distinguish shipped, local-only, deferred and outside-owner entries. Keep M7 release gate open until the coverage review and follow-up program are qualified.

achievements.achievement: Define named formal consumer, complete certificate/trusted-base domain, bounded failure/resources and source-free owner admission conditions.
Verify historical certificate/source SHA pins and independently reproduce exact convolution and invalid versus unproved negative verdicts.
Explicitly defer Lean/Rocq/SMT toolchains and public Math proof APIs with three future admission triggers, no kernel claims.
Qualify bounded formal provider/trusted-base disposition through a read-only C# source-pinned owner gate.
Close formal interoperability as a finite certificate research spike; no external proof kernel, solver, public package or Math formal API delivered.
